module.name: finance.expense-approval
module.purpose: Let people claim work expenses that are approved by someone with sufficient authority and never by the claimant.

objects.name: within-limit
claims: An approver with a limit of 500 and an expense of 120 from someone else.

objects.name: over-limit
claims: An approver with a limit of 500 and an expense of 900.
The approver tries to approve the expense.
The approval is refused and the expense stays submitted.

objects.name: self-approval
claims: An approver with a sufficient limit who submitted the expense.
The approver tries to approve the expense.

objects.name: rejection
claims: A submitted expense and an eligible approver.
The approver rejects it with a reason.
The expense becomes rejected and the submitter can see the reason.

objects.name: approver-limit-covers-amount
claims: An expense is approved only by an approver whose limit covers its amount.

objects.name: no-self-decision
claims: A person cannot approve or reject their own expense.

objects.name: decision-is-final
claims: A decided expense cannot be decided again.

objects.name: rejection-has-reason
claims: A rejection records a reason visible to the submitter.

objects.name: no-eligible-approver
claims: What happens when no one other than the submitter has a limit covering the amount?

objects.name: submit-expense
claims: Every submitted expense is routed only to approvers other than the submitter.
